scope: Targeted research for identity, semantic binding and typed dedup; not systematic exhaustive review or clinical model evaluation

sources.title: Biomedical Entity Representations with Synonym Marginalization
sources.primary_access: full PDF including Methods and §6.2 Error Analysis
claims_used: Sparse/dense candidate retrieval, synonym marginalization and iterative candidate updating.
Reported error categories include contextual entity, overlap, abbreviations and hierarchy.
sources.proposed_use: candidate retrieval, not same-as or rule-effect certification
sources.limits: Entity normalization benchmark does not establish clinical rule fidelity or hard action safety.

sources.title: Self-Alignment Pretraining for Biomedical Entity Representations (SapBERT)
sources.primary_access: full author camera-ready HTML; ACL PDF fetch failed, canonical ACL abstract verified
claims_used: Metric learning aligns same-concept UMLS names with hard pairs.
The task explicitly excludes mention context and uses nearest-neighbor prediction.
sources.limits: Similarity is not verified identity, scope, or diagnostic implication.

sources.title: BELHD: Improving Biomedical Entity Linking with Homonym Disambiguation
sources.primary_access: full January 2024 author manuscript; final publisher metadata crosschecked, PMC fetch challenged; no claim numerical results identical across versions
claims_used: KB homonyms augmented with disambiguating names.
Contextual mention encoding and candidate sharing.
Experiments use in-KB gold mention spans, and nonunique predictions are incorrect.
sources.proposed_use: context-aware relation disambiguation and homonym handling
sources.limits: Unique KB names are not guaranteed correct mention linking; NIL behavior is not demonstrated by this setting.

sources.title: A Simple Algorithm for Identifying Abbreviation Definitions in Biomedical Text
claims_used: 96% precision and 82% recall on the authors standard evaluation; scope of definition extraction differs from disambiguation.
sources.proposed_use: source-local abbreviation table with definition provenance
sources.limits: Unstated definitions, partial matches and cross-document sense differences remain.

sources.title: SNOMED CT Data Analytics Guide: SNOMED CT Overview
claims_used: Subsumption and equivalence are separate formal comparisons.
sources.proposed_use: typed mapping classes and explicit directed inheritance proofs
sources.limits: Retrieval subsumption does not authorize arbitrary diagnostic criterion transfer.

sources.title: LOINC Users Guide: Major Parts of a LOINC Term
claims_used: Component, Property, Time, System, Scale, and Method distinguish observations.
sources.proposed_use: typed observation identity before numeric or marker joins
sources.limits: Observation coding does not imply performed testing, positive result, or disease confirmation.

sources.title: UCUM Specification
sources.primary_access: official specification, syntax and prefix/unit definitions
claims_used: UCUM distinguishes case-sensitive symbols from separately specified case-insensitive symbols.
Units admit formal dimensional interpretation and conversions.
sources.proposed_use: unit parser/converter plus robust invalid state
sources.limits: Dimensional compatibility cannot identify the measurand, specimen or temporal scope.

sources.title: NLM UCUM Unit Conversion Web Service
sources.primary_access: official API description; no endpoint executed
claims_used: NLM exposes UCUM unit conversion APIs.
sources.proposed_use: reference interface for deterministic conversion rather than ad hoc unit aliases
sources.limits: API is a conversion aid, not a clinical observation equivalence checker.
